items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So we talked to Major Adams about it.

ctx.x: Then we went to, things were quiet there just before the Battle of the Bulge deal. So we left that area in the Ardennes Forest and went to a town called EUPEN. They pronounce it over there YOU-PEN. We pronounce it (OY-PEN). EUPEN. And they set us up in hotels and everything. And it was a rest area where the soldiers would come in from the front and get a hot bath and a whole new uniform and they could go around to the different Red Cross places and they lived in hotels. And their meals were free. Good home cooked…

And then we used to play in a theater, the Capitol Theater it was. And when we went to this theater we got it all set up for us to do our show; and terrible piano. The piano was absolutely, it was terrible. Marian, said, oh my God, she said I can't, what am I going to do? I can't play this thing. So we talked to Major Adams about it. He was the Special Service Officer and Major Adams says to me, he says, a little later he says, Jimmy, he says "I'll give you an order what we call a requisition order." He says,…

Nazi homes, collaborators and Nazis that were in town here and they have all the best stuff." And he said, "we have written down here what they have in their homes and everything and there's a place over here that has a brand new grand piano." You know, well these were the collaborators you know and they had all the best stuff.
